events.text: I'll build the Clerk webhook receiver on the centre Worker, then probe it and deploy. First I'm locating the existing Dodo signature scheme and the spec sections this route must follow.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate Dodo webhook route and spec sections
events.input: $ /Users/adithyamurali/.local/bin/codebase-memory-mcp cli search_graph '{"project":"Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign","query":"hooks dodo clerk webhook signature svix","limit":15}' && echo "---SPEC---" && rg -n "hooks/dodo|CLERK_WEBHOOK|section 5|ended list|embed session" workshop-plan/specs/TANTRA_INSOURCE_SPEC.md | head -80 && echo "---CLOUD SRC---" && ls cloud/src && echo "---ROUTES---" && rg -n "hooks/dodo|fetch\\(|pathname" cloud/src --glob '!*.test.*' -g '!node_modules' | head -40

events.text: The graph search returned mostly app-side hits. Let me look directly in the cloud worker source.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find Dodo route and spec headings
events.input: $ rg -n "hooks/dodo|svix|webhook-id|webhook-timestamp" cloud/src -g '!node_modules' | head -40; echo "=== SRC LIST ==="; ls cloud/src; echo "=== SPEC ROWS ==="; rg -n "^## |^### " workshop-plan/specs/TANTRA_INSOURCE_SPEC.md | head -40

events.text: The Dodo route is in `cloud/src/payments.ts`. Let me read it and the spec sections.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read Dodo webhook verification and route wiring
events.input: $ sed -n '1,120p' cloud/src/payments.ts; echo "=== ENV ==="; rg -n "DODO_WEBHOOK_SECRET|CLERK" cloud/src/env.d.ts cloud/src/util.ts | head -30; echo "=== INDEX ROUTE BLOCK ==="; sed -n '1060,1110p' cloud/src/index.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find signature verification function location
events.input: $ rg -n "function verify|function hmac|webhook-timestamp|MAX_SKEW|5 \* 60|reject" cloud/src/payments.ts | head -20; echo "=== ENV D ==="; sed -n '1,80p' cloud/src/env.d.ts | rg -n "SECRET|secret" ; echo "=== UTIL TYPE ENV ==="; rg -n "DODO_WEBHOOK_SECRET|STRIPE_WEBHOOK" cloud/src/util.ts cloud/src/env.d.ts
